title: Build content pipeline MVP
description: Implement the full guides/ content ingestion pipeline: project skeleton, LLM clients, queue/storage, fetchers, processors, tags, verify, orchestrator, stream/cron entrypoint. See docs/plans/2026-05-11-guides-mvp-implementation.md

title: Task 1: Project skeleton
description: pyproject.toml, .env.example, guides/__init__.py, guides/settings.py. Azure env + data paths + prompt dir. Verify: uv run python -c 'from guides.settings import Settings; print(ok)'

title: Task 4: Source detection + shared models
description: guides/fetch/base.py: SourceType enum (ARTICLE/YOUTUBE/GITHUB_REPO), QueueItem, FetchedContent, detect_source_type(). Verify: sample URLs map to correct SourceType.

title: Task 2: LLM clients + prompt files
description: guides/llm.py (cached AzureOpenAI smart/fast + load_prompt helper), guides/prompts/*.md (5 files: article_rewrite, youtube_summary, github_reference, tags_extract, verify_check). Verify: load_prompt returns non-empty string.

title: Task 3: Queue + canonical storage
description: guides/queue.py (pop_pending/mark_done for data/queue/inbox.txt), guides/vault.py (YYYY-MM-DD_{hash8}/ layout, source.md immutable, meta.json), data dirs. Verify: write a fake source, check folder created.

title: Task 8: Tags + verify
description: guides/enrich/tags.py (fast model, JSON tag list), guides/verify.py (output exists, title, tags, not empty, code blocks not dropped, up to 3 retry attempts, status=needs_review on fail). Verify: one passing + one intentionally broken sample.

title: Task 7: Processors
description: guides/process/article.py (rewrite, keep code/prompts verbatim), guides/process/youtube.py (transcript + chunk if needed), guides/process/reference.py (GitHub repo: what/stack/use-cases/concepts/quickstart/links). Each reads its prompt .md. Verify: fixture input → markdown output with title.

title: Task 6: YouTube + GitHub fetchers
description: guides/fetch/youtube.py: yt-dlp --write-auto-sub --skip-download, parse .vtt, fallback youtubetranscribe.khabaroff.studio. guides/fetch/github.py: GitHub API repo metadata + README. Verify: one real YT URL + one GitHub repo URL.

title: Task 5: URL fetcher
description: guides/fetch/url.py. Primary: defuddle-cli subprocess call. Fallback: HTTP request with Accept: text/markdown header. Returns FetchedContent. Verify: fetch one real article URL, get non-empty markdown.

title: Task 10: Stream + cron entrypoint
description: process_stream.py: reads data/queue/inbox.txt + scans data/inbox/, normalizes to QueueItem, calls guides.run, writes logs. cron/crontab.example with one entry. Verify: uv run python process_stream.py, queue items processed.

title: Task 9: Orchestrator
description: guides/run.py: wire detect → fetch → process → tag → verify → store. Status handling: success/failed/needs_review. Verify: end-to-end on 3 samples (article URL, YouTube URL, GitHub repo URL), output folders in data/sources/.
